scope: Proposition 8.1 (Nonvanishing of every cap limit) of the manuscript “Nonuniqueness for the periodic hard-sphere Boltzmann equation” (preprints/Nonuniqueness-for-the-periodic-hard-sphere-Boltzmann-equation-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 363 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9cf0253f6b105302), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 42. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Consider any sequence of cap shots with horizons Tn → 0, approximation indices Nn → ∞, and sNn /Tn → 0. Make the rescaling (7.1), and pass to any subsequence supplied by Proposition 7.1. Its limit satisfies g ̸≡ 0 on (0, U) × R3 x × R3 v. This conclusion includes l = 1, U = 1, and U = ∞.
